adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, immediately after `const credentialKey = credential.key ...`, the code unconditionally POSTs to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` and then unconditionally calls `prisma.credential.update(...)` before returning a new `jsforce.Connection`. There is no expiry/"is expired" guard around this refresh+DB write, so any code path that builds a connection will pay the extra network round-trip and DB write even if the access token is still valid. That’s a real, diff-grounded performance/rate-limit concern, not a directly provable functional defect from the diff alone.
